data.title: Friction from using kadence on kadence, 2026-10-12
data.description: The notes this journal collected while building 0.9: claim left tasks in backlog and did not show criteria; text starting with -- was refused; the unknown-action text omitted four actions; task list had no --milestone; the onboarding Undo line wrapped mid-word; a board-wide definition of done was noise on work that is not code.
